<!--
Thanks for the PR. One maintainer reviews these in spare time, so small and focused is best.
Title: conventional commit in plain words, e.g. "fix(merge): loss check no longer flags moved prefabs".
Scopes: cli, merge, council, workspace, unity, docs, ci, tests.
For anything bigger than an obvious fix, open an issue or discussion first.
-->

## Problem

<!-- What was wrong or missing, in a sentence or two. Link the issue or discussion if there is one. -->

## Change

<!-- What you changed and why this way. If it touches both the Python CLI and the Unity package, say why both are needed. -->

## Verification

<!-- What you ran and what you saw. Name the test modules, e.g.
`python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_merge.py"`.
Say whether you ran the full suite (it takes 40+ minutes) or left it to CI.
For Unity-side changes: Unity version, and what you did in the Editor.
Say what you could NOT check. -->

## Notes for the reviewer

<!-- Optional: anything risky, open questions, follow-ups you deliberately left out.
If an agent wrote part of this, name the model and harness. -->
